name: edge-paid-without-payment
description: A seeded edge case beside the business-rule baits: a receipt for a paid invoice takes its date and method from the first payment, and the class itself has markPaidExternally, which sets PAID and, as its doc says, records no Payment. A receipt for such an invoice reads get(0) of an empty list and throws. Seeded.

expected.why: markPaidExternally sets PAID without a Payment, so receiptFor on such an invoice calls get(0) on an empty list.
